wins_analysis: No wins today. The single pending order for ITC BUY at 285.59 was never filled, meaning price did not pull back to the demand zone entry level during the session. This is consistent with a strong trending_up day where stocks gap up and run without retracing.
losses_analysis: No losses today either, but the broader context is critical: the strategy has 11 consecutive losing trades over 5 weeks with a 0% win rate. Today's non-execution avoided adding to the losing streak, but the system's inability to find high-conviction setups (only 1 setup with score 45/60 and 38% probability) in a strong uptrend day (+2.6% Nifty) signals a fundamental mismatch between zone-based mean-reversion entries and trending market behavior.
regime_impact: The trending_up regime with Nifty +2.6% and low VIX (12.2) strongly favored momentum/breakout strategies over demand zone pullback entries. Stocks in a strong uptrend rarely retrace to demand zones intraday, causing limit orders to go unfilled. The regime actively hurt the current pullback-to-zone strategy.

improvements.action: Add a breakout/momentum entry mode for trending_up regimes with Nifty gain >1.5% — use entries at breakout of intraday high or prior day high instead of demand zone pullbacks
improvements.reason: ITC never pulled back to 285.59 on a +2.6% Nifty day. Strong trend days leave limit orders unfilled. 11 consecutive losses suggest the zone-pullback approach is structurally wrong for current conditions.

improvements.action: Raise minimum zone score threshold to 55/60 AND minimum AI probability to 50% before placing any order — skip the day entirely if no setup qualifies
improvements.reason: Today's sole setup had score 45/60 and 38% AI probability, well below quality thresholds. The system correctly identified low conviction but still placed the order. Enforce hard filters to prevent capital deployment on sub-par setups.

improvements.action: Require trend alignment score ≥7/10 for any BUY setup in trending_up regime — reject counter-trend setups (ITC had 4/10 trend score)
improvements.reason: ITC's 4/10 trend score means it was not participating in the broad market rally. Buying laggards via demand zones in a strong uptrend is counter-productive; focus on leaders making new highs.

improvements.action: Implement a circuit breaker: after 5 consecutive losses, reduce position size by 50% and require probability ≥55% to re-engage. After 10 consecutive losses, pause live orders for 3 days and only paper-test signals.
improvements.reason: 11 consecutive losses indicates the strategy edge has disappeared in current market conditions. Continued deployment without structural changes is capital destruction.
